sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु कुपितः खडगम् उद्धृत्य लक्ष्मणः ।कर्ण नास स्तनम् तस्या निचकर्ता अरिसूदनः ॥३-६९-१७॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu kupitaḥ khaḍagam uddhṛtya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।karṇa nāsa stanam tasyā nicakartā arisūdanaḥ ॥3-69-17॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Lakshmana, subduer of enemies, became angry, took out the sword and cut off her ears, nose and breasts.
